name: Takagaki Kaede
source:
Kaede is a mature and mysterious idol. She is very quiet, never saying more than necessary. Her hobbies are visiting and relaxing in onsen. She's also is a huge fan of lame puns and can continue for hours with this if the Producer can’t stop it. She can instantly smell the difference between body wash and shampoo products and has a beauty mark under her right eye.

[From [url=http://www.project-imas.com/wiki/Kaede_Takagaki]Project IM@S Wiki[/url]]
